title: UNIVERSAL TELEPORT
features:
FEATURES (ENGLISH)

* Save unlimited checkpoints anywhere in the map with one click
* Instantly teleport back to any saved location without delay
* Clean neon checkpoint markers placed automatically in the world
* Fully draggable UI (icon & menu) for flexible positioning
* Simple checkpoint manager with quick access buttons
* Delete checkpoints anytime with a single tap
* Real-time updating list system (no refresh needed)
* Lightweight and optimized, no performance drop
* Works seamlessly after respawn (GUI stays active)
* Minimalist, modern design that fits any game style

Make your game smoother, faster, and more fun.
Give players full control over their movement and progression.
Perfect for obby, adventure, open-world, and exploration games.
Simple system, powerful experience.

FITUR (INDONESIA)

* Simpan checkpoint tanpa batas di mana aja dengan sekali klik
* Teleport langsung ke lokasi yang sudah disimpan tanpa delay
* Marker neon otomatis muncul biar gampang dikenali
* UI fleksibel, bisa digeser bebas (icon & menu)
* Sistem manajemen checkpoint yang simpel dan cepat
* Hapus checkpoint kapan aja dengan sekali tekan
* List otomatis update tanpa perlu refresh
* Ringan, tidak membebani performa game
* Tetap aktif walau karakter respawn
* Desain minimalis, cocok untuk semua jenis game

Bikin gameplay lebih cepat, praktis, dan seru.
Kasih player kontrol penuh buat eksplorasi map.
Cocok buat obby, adventure, open world, dan lainnya.
Simple tapi impact-nya kerasa.
